# v1.0.0: Audit My App with Claude

Audit My App with Claude turns a running web application into reviewable visual evidence and reusable design-system documentation.

## Included

- Capture route and tab screenshots with stable route-based filenames.
- Record 1080p demo walkthroughs with captions, key screenshots, a narration script, and an FFmpeg rebuild script.
- Build a component library from rendered UI, including purpose, anatomy, variants, measured styles, markup, screenshots, icons, and candidate DTCG design tokens.
- Audit visual and source-level inconsistencies such as near-duplicate colors, sprawling type and spacing scales, repeated component variants, and hardcoded values.
- Package component documentation, candidate tokens, audit findings, page screenshots, and instructions into a Claude Design handoff archive.
- Map captured components to shadcn/ui, generate the corresponding install command, and draft an OKLCH `globals.css` theme.
- Protect capture runs with human-only login, read-only navigation, off-origin blocking, redaction and screenshot masks, destructive-action guards, and demo-plan approval.

Candidate tokens and component mappings require human review before adoption.

## Install

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add legioncodeinc/app-auditor-plugin-claude
claude plugin install webapp-capture@legioncodeinc
```

Then run:

```text
/webapp-capture doctor
/webapp-capture all http://localhost:3000
```

## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or newer
- Chromium for Playwright
- FFmpeg for demo-video assembly
- A running local, staging, or synthetic demo application

## Downloads

- `webapp-capture-plugin-1.0.0.zip`: full plugin for Claude Cowork and compatible plugin environments
- `webapp-capture-stinger-1.0.0.skill`: skill-only distribution for claude.ai; script-based capture still requires a runtime with Node.js and a browser
- `SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 checksums for both downloads

Verify the downloads with:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
```
